blockchain.excerpt: Tokenization is not just about putting individual stocks and funds onchain. The next step could be entire investment portfolios that can be traded, rebalanced and eventually managed in real-time.

blockchain.title: NEAR Intents recovers entire stolen $3.8M after ultimatum to exploiter
blockchain.excerpt: The exploiter returned the entire sum to NEAR Intents after being identified and given 48 hours to respond.

blockchain.title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test

blockchain.title: Ethereum Now Lets You Pay for AI Without Revealing Who You Are
blockchain.excerpt: Ethereum's zkAPI lets users prepay in USDC and query AI models through cryptographic proofs, so no single party sees both who they are and what they ask.

blockchain.title: Blast to wind down Ethereum L2 after costs outpace revenue
blockchain.excerpt: Once among Ethereum’s largest layer-2 networks by total value locked, Blast is urging users to move their assets to mainnet ahead of the shutdown.

defi.excerpt: The USDC issuer told the European Commission that MiCA's reserve mandates and concentration caps keep the largest global stablecoins outside Europe's perimeter—siding with the ECB in calling for more flexible rules.
